void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, body borders, all text in dark contexts — the default background every other element sits on

bone-cream.$description: Bone Cream — Primary text color, button fills, surface highlights — warm off-white that reads as paper, not screen white

ash-taupe.$description: Ash Taupe — Button box-shadow tint — the single warm-gray accent in the system

alarm-red.$description: Alarm Red — Hazard icons, strikethrough editorial links, flame illustrations, concentric radar rings — the only chromatic signal in the system, reserved for things requiring attention

spektra.$description: Display and heading face — extremely condensed, near-black weight even at 400, used for the campaign title and brand wordmark at poster sizes

helvetica-neue-lt.$description: Body, subheadings, UI text — quiet humanist sans at 400 for body, 800 for emphasized subheads and footer marks
